exercises.instruction: Write the uncountable noun for each picture. We give you the first letter each time.
Put these nouns into two columns: countable and uncountable.

items: 1 Are these furnitures new? I haven't seen them before. (2 marks)
2 We had a terrible weather last week!
3 We have ten people coming to lunch, so we'll need three large breads.
4 Can you give me some advices about English courses in the UK?
5 The traffics are always very bad around 8 o'clock in the morning.
6 The news are on TV in five minutes. Shall we watch them? (2 marks)
7 Rail travels are more interesting than going by air.
8 I have a lot of works to do before the exam next week.
